C0398.title: Account Warming Crosses Legal Red Line, Leads to Prison Sentence
C0398.summary: The defendant Li discovered an overseas pornographic website in 2023 and used pornographic posts to attract traffic and warm up accounts. He collected pornographic images and videos, posted 879 threads containing 906 short videos on the site, and 831 of those videos were identified as obscene. He attracted more than 7,000 WeChat contacts, planned to sell the account at a high price, and also posted counterfeit-shoe advertisements, gaining more than 20,000 yuan illegally. After prosecution by the Hanjiang District People's Procuratorate, Li was sentenced to eight months in prison for disseminating obscene materials.
